evals.prompt: I'm about to submit my app for the first time to both the App Store and Google Play. The project is at skills/store-review/tests/fixtures/bad-app. Will it pass review? Tell me what I need to fix.
assertions: The report gives a clear verdict (ready, ready after fixes, or not ready)
Every finding cites a specific Apple guideline section number or a named Google Play policy
Every finding points at evidence in the project (a file, a config key or a dependency)
Every finding comes with a concrete fix
It separates what blocks submission from what is only a risk, and from tasks done in the store consoles
It flags the missing account deletion (Apple 5.1.1(v))
It flags Google Sign-In without Sign in with Apple (Apple 4.8)
It flags the missing restore purchases (Apple 3.1.1)
It flags the development-client production build
It flags the ads SDK without App Tracking Transparency
